_meta.description: Per-category, per-word practice sentences for SPEAKING PRACTICE mode. Three sentences per word, ordered by difficulty: S1 = 3-4 words, S2 = 4-5 words, S3 = 5-7 words. Age target: 4-7. The agent models the exact sentence; the app scores the whole sentence (not just the lesson word).
